every row is created in a single atomic commit ... Created users hold no credential from the import and receive no message from it (R-12).
size and row-count limits are configured values (`max_bytes`, `max_rows` ...); exceeding either rejects the whole file before any user is created (G-1: default values unresolved).

verdicts.quote: a 0-byte file returns `empty_file`; `email,name,role\n` returns `no_data_rows` ... Boundary: a one-data-row file creates one user.

The request is parsed, validated and committed inside the single request, and the response is the final outcome. The file is bounded by `max_bytes` and `max_rows`
